tenderSchedule.title: CEE/KLB/66kV CTs
tenderSchedule.description: Tender for Design, Manufacture, Testing and supply of 66kV Current Transformers of various ratios required various sub-stations of Operations Divisions coming under Transmission Operations Zone Kalaburagi conforming to Technical Specifications, FORD at Store/Site basis, including insurance, transportation & unloading
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPTCL CEE Transmission Zone Office Kalburgi

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

For Micro and Small Scale Enterprises:Micro and small enterprises registered with NSIC under a single point vendor registration scheme are exempted from payment of Earnest Money deposit. However, Tender Processing Fee, for an amount as mentioned in the Karnataka Public Procurement portal shall be paid in Karnataka Public Procurement portal. The Tenderer shall upload the valid certificate issued by NSIC certifying that it is a Micro and Small Enterprises registered with NSIC under a single point vendor registration scheme.Such eligible Micro and Small enterprises (SMEs) have to select EMD exemption feature in Karnataka Public Procurement portal.The exemption and relaxation in EMD is subject to the validity & acceptance of the supporting documents by the Purchaser.Other than Micro and Small scale Enterprises:The Tenderer shall deposit, as part of his tender, Earnest Money Deposit/Bid Security (EMD) for Rs. 41,000/- (Rupees Forty One Thousand Only) through Karnataka Public Procurement portal by any of the modes specified in KPP Portal.Any other form of payment will not be accepted

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall upload the performance certificates for at least 50% (25% in respect of Micro & small enterprises) i.e 16 nos (08 Nos. in respect of Micro & small enterprises) of 66kV or higher voltage class CTs.The performance certificate shall pertain only to the Current Transformers commissioned in State/Central owned Transmission Utilities/Generation Utilities.The issuing officer of performance certificates shall not be below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent Division head. The performance certificate shall indicate all necessary details such as raring of the equipment, make, voltage, name of the substation where it is installed, date of commissioning etc., in order to show that the above Current transformers were in successful operation for atleast a minimum period of two years as on the date of bid submission. Tenderers shall have to upload the relevant performance certificates.Micro & small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME (UDYAM) registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that tenderer is a Micro and small Enterprises.

The Tenderer should have manufactured and supplied at least 50% (25% in respect Micro & small enterprises) 16 nos (08 Nos. in respect of Micro & small enterprises) of 66kV or higher voltage class CTs to State/Central owned Transmission Utilities/Generation Utilities. Micro & Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME (UDYAM) registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that tenderer is a Micro and Small Enterprises.(Tenderers shall have to upload the supporting Documents such as Purchase Micro & Small Enterprises shall upload valid MSME (UDYAM) registration certificate obtained from the competent authority certifying that tenderer is a Micro and Small Enterprises.order copies, order completion certificates/performance certificates issued by State/Central owned Transmission Utilities/Generation Utilities).

The Average annual Financial Turnover of the Tenderer for best three years out of last preceding five financial years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 , 2024-25 and 2025-26) should not be less than the Amount put to tender i.e Rs. 41.00 Lakhs. However, it shall be Rs. 21.00 Lakhs in respect of Micro & Small Enterprises.
Liquid asset as per Clause No.6 (11) of NIT

The Tenderer shall upload Test Reports not older than Ten years on the date of bid submission for having conducted successful type tests and additional type tests as specified in tender technical specifications, on 110kV class Current Transformer as per relevant IS/IEC standards as designated laboratories brought out in NIT

The tenderer shall upload Guaranteed Technical Particulars of each rating of material/equipment specified in Annexure-A of the present enquiry in the prescribed format uploaded in Techno-commercial sheet, failing which the bid document is liable for rejection

The Tenderer shall be a Manufacturer and should have a minimum experience of Five years in designing, manufacturing, testing and supply of 66kV or higher class current transformers as on the date of bid submission.(Tenderer shall to upload the supporting documents such as purchase order/order completion certificates/performance certificates demonstrating experience of minimum 5 years as Manufacturer of material/equipment specified in the tender).

The Tenderer should have Goods and Service Tax (GST) registration with GSTIN number and PAN details.(Bidder shall upload the necessary supporting document to establish compliance for having GST registration & PAN).

The tenderer shall be individual proprietorship firm or partnership firm or Company registered under Companies Act 1956/2013. Tenderer shall upload registration certificate /SSI certificate/Udyam certificate(MSME)/Partnership deed/license issued by the Commerce & Industries department or any other Government statutory Authority shall be uploaded. For proprietorship firm, PAN and GST registration certificate shall be uploaded.

The Tenderer should not have been DEFAULTED in supplies against Purchase Orders placed by any State/Central Generating/ Transmission Utility/ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs.Self-declaration in the prescribed format shall be uploaded.

The Tenderer should not be under order of debarment/Blacklisting from participating in a Tender by any State/Central Generating/ Transmission Utility/ESCOMs/Distribution companies or any Government Electrical Utilities/ PSUs, as on the last date of submission of bids. Self-declaration in the prescribed format shall be uploaded.

Litigation History:The Tenderer should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the preceding five years. A consistent history of awards involving litigation against the Tenderer or any partner may result in rejection of Bid.Self-declaration in this regard shall be uploaded.
